international.title: Apec summit live: Xi and Putin speak as world leaders gather in China
international.summary: Summit in Chinese tech hub Shenzhen set to include highly anticipated meeting between Xi, Trump and Putin Shenzhen takes centre stage as Xi sends ‘Chinamaxxing’ message at Apec summit What is Apec? Explained in 30 seconds We’re back for day two of the Apec CEO Summit in China’s southern tech hub of Shenzhen . Today the summit will be addressed by APEC leaders, with President Xi Jinping set to give a keynote speech . Bilateral meetings will continue on the sidelines, although the most eye-catching – Xi and Donald Trump , and the US-China-Russia trilateral – won’t be until Thursday. Vladimir Putin arrived in Shenzhen this morning, greeted by a red carpet, soldiers and pom pom-waving dancers dressed in fuchsia and blue. Communist party politburo member Cai Qi , often described as Xi’s right-hand man, was there to meet him. They are working very hard to make sure that we can have a common language.” Continue reading...
